# Kibitzz

> Kibitzz is a chess scoresheet scanner and game coach app. You photograph a handwritten chess scoresheet; Kibitzz reconstructs the game move by move, validates every move against the rules, analyzes it with the Stockfish engine, and explains the critical moments in plain English. A typical 40-move game goes from photo to playable, engine-checked game in about 8 seconds.

Kibitzz is built by ATIMIS (https://www.atimis.in/). Contact: contact@kibitzz.in

## Key facts

- What it reads: standard handwritten scoresheets, photo uploads and PGN files, including messy tournament notation.
- What you get: a playable game, Stockfish analysis with critical moments and player accuracy, and a plain-English summary of where the game changed, what was missed and how to improve.
- Export: PGN export so digitized games can be opened in any engine or chess database.
- Offline: scoresheets can be captured offline and queue up; digitization and engine analysis run once the device is back online.
- Privacy: games are stored securely, synced only to the user's account and never sold; users can export or delete them.
- Platforms: Android (Google Play, Android 9 or later). iOS (iOS 15 or later) is listed as coming soon.
- Who it is for: tournament and club players, improving players, and coaches and clubs.
